subject: documents.records

recordTypes.summary: One governed index record for a retained shared document or link.

fields.summary: The governed audiences permitted or intended to use the document.
The current governed subject categories for the artifact.
One factual line explaining what the document is and why it is retained.
Exact workspace actor identities for the human steward accountable for this document-index record; this does not imply meeting chair, participant, author, or ownership of the linked artifact.
Exact organization resource identities related to the document.
Exact evidenced Project resource identities related to the document.
Exact evidenced Task resource identities related to the document.
Exact evidenced opportunity resource identities related to the document.

content.summary: The shared index row points to the artifact and does not duplicate its content.

limitations: This model owns portable document-index meaning only; provider schemas, option sets, relation targets, permissions, and current records require Integration observations.
The governed context.docs vocabulary artifact owns the exact current doc and private-workspace doc terms and definitions.
Private-workspace documents and meeting source records are outside this shared index model and must not be promoted into it implicitly.
Document-index owner means the steward accountable for the record; Meeting participation, chairing, attendance, or absence cannot establish ownership.
